source: a game where you have a garage and make money and hire workers limited people 4 players. there is roads and your friends walking around well you ask them for a job so you can unlock the garage buisness

answers.ask: Do the four players share one garage, or does each get their own plot?
answers.answer: Each of the up to four players gets their own garage plot, so they can build their own garage business and hire workers.

answers.ask: Does a round end when the garage is fully built out, or is it a persistent world you keep coming back to?
answers.answer: It is a persistent world where players keep returning to earn money, hire workers, and unlock more of their garage business.

## Clarifications resolved
- [author] shape — Q: Do the four players share one garage, or does each get their own plot? A: Each of the up to four players gets their own garage plot, so they can build their own garage business and hire workers.
- [author] goal — Q: Does a round end when the garage is fully built out, or is it a persistent world you keep coming back to? A: It is a persistent world where players keep returning to earn money, hire workers, and unlock more of their garage business.
- [agent_inferred] theme — Q: What visual setting should the unspecified garage world use? A: Use a plain modern functional garage district, directly grounded in the requested roads and garage businesses.
- [agent_inferred] garage enterability — Q: Do players and hired workers enter the garage buildings? A: Yes; make each garage an enterable work building because the business activity occurs inside it.

## Enriched image prompt
Create a persistent modern garage-business world for up to four players. Arrange exactly four large, independent garage plots with equal spacing so each player can build and expand without overlapping another business. Connect all plot entrances with a simple vehicle-width road network and separate clear pedestrian circulation for friends and hired workers. On every plot, include an enterable garage work building, a visible job or work station, room for worker activity, and physically marked expansion sections that can unlock as the business grows. Keep the four plots balanced in size and access while making each read as its own self-contained garage operation.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Simulation, canonical slug `simulation`, because persistent money earning, worker hiring, business building, and unlock progression form a tycoon loop.

## Shape and preset
Use `plot-isolated`, spelled Isolated Per-Player Plots in Simulation, for exactly four independent garage businesses. Match the Tycoon preset but substitute isolated plots for its shared team plot; retain progression gates and circulation while omitting an unrequested shared upgrade bazaar.

## Config requirements
Use `gate-progression` for visible locked expansion sections on each plot. Use `path-circulation` for pedestrian routes between roads, plot entrances, and work areas. Use `path-road-vehicle` as a street network rather than a race course, so it uses P0. Use `trigger-task` for a visible garage work or job station on each plot. Use universal `building-interior` for each enterable garage and `npc-population` for hired workers.

## Layout requirements
Place the layout half of `trigger-task` exactly four times, once in each garage work area. Place the layout half of `npc-population` as worker positions within each player's garage and plot, with counts determined by hiring progression rather than fixed scenery. Money, hiring, unlock state, and persistent saves are gameplay systems.

## Layout components
Build exactly four equally sized isolated garage plots, four enterable garage buildings, four work stations, four sets of expansion sections, one shared road network, and pedestrian walkways linking every plot entrance. Keep plots separated by clear boundaries, orient all garages toward the road, and compose the four-business district symmetrically enough that no player plot has a travel advantage.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: render the garage architecture, plot ownership, roads, and business composition first, then derive the top-down view; the isometric image is authoritative because the simple district does not require computed route topology.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use medium scale, driven by four legible garage buildings, plots, roads, and worker areas. The theme is a modern functional garage district. Use `P3` because play crosses between the outdoor plots and enterable garage interiors.
